equation: dX = Y * dt;  dY = -X * dt + sigma * dW
milstein_correction: 0 (additive noise, Milstein == EM; multi-D requires Levy area anyway)
implementation_notes: 2D linear SDE (stochastic harmonic oscillator). Noise enters only the Y (velocity) component: diffusion matrix G = [[0],[sigma]]. X update has no stochastic term (X_{n+1} = X_n + Y_n*dt); Y update is Y_{n+1} = Y_n - X_n*dt + sigma*dW_n. Additive noise and state_dimension>1 => EM only, Milstein not applicable. At T=2*pi: mean_X ~= 1.0, mean_Y ~= 0.0 (near zero, skip mean check on Y per near_zero_mean_threshold). Both variances grow ~ sigma^2/2 * t and are strictly positive.
